mainEntity.name: How long do functional layout improvement projects typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a functional layout improvement project depends on its complexity and scope. Minor changes, like non-load-bearing wall removal or minor reconfigurations, might take a few weeks. More extensive projects involving structural changes, plumbing, or electrical rerouting, and multiple room renovations, can extend to several months. Permitting in cities like Berkeley or Oakland can also add to the timeline. We establish a clear project schedule upfront, and maintaining open communication about potential adjustments helps manage expectations throughout the construction phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by complexity; minor changes take weeks, while extensive structural renovations can take months. Permitting timelines, especially in the East Bay, can also affect the schedule.
